limits: Alternate compositions of named entries only. No elements package or workspace source aliases.
Native semantic and computed-style scenarios only; manual AT, native clipboard transport, SSR/hydration and full theme visual acceptance remain separate.

runtime.policy: Locally resolved browser installations and executable bytes; no inference from package version alone.

earlierAttempts.boundary: Strict test compilation required native textarea type annotations; browsers did not run.
Application registration callback accessed its popup before the render root existed; guarded constructor-time access.
68 passed,1 failed,99 not run: Firefox synthetic ClipboardEvent exposes a different clipboardData channel; copy assertion read the constructor input.
69 passed,1 failed,98 not run: paste payload likewise needed population on the actual event channel.
168 browser and39 Node cases passed before final inventory binding.

buildReuse.reason: This batch changes packed qualification fixtures and source documentation, not the docs application or library runtime.

limitations: Ten additional entries have bounded consumer qualification;98/110 entries qualified and12 remain pending.

The native textarea plus token preview is an alternate composition, not an inline rich-token backend. Native rich notes exercise styling and retained formatted DOM, not rich persistence or formatted-paste sanitization.
Chat and collaboration run in JS and portable CSS; token/rich editor styles are JS-only. No owning-element runtime changed.

Synthetic ClipboardEvent payloads use the event clipboardData channel, which Firefox constructs independently of the supplied DataTransfer. These tests do not establish OS clipboard transport. Synthetic composition guards do not establish physical IME.

Manual AT, physical touch, retail products, full SSR/hydration, caret collision controls, large-history virtualization and separate-owner obligations remain. Historical external CSS-authoring rerun is retired, never passed.
